risks: Post-grasp target may be occluded and native task may fail; empty perception is never treated as success.
Unknown motion still propagates to independent Safety and hard-stops.
One seed-9001 smoke is safe but does not prove multi-seed reliability.
selection_reason: Public /perceive uses segmentation; post-grasp empty detection is an expected visibility limit. The policy ends motion cleanly and leaves native failure to the independent evaluator.
